standardise_flex

Source: R/flex_functions.R
standardise_flex.Rd

Matrix scaling.

Usage

standardise_flex(x, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)

Arguments

x

matrix

center

center data

scale

scale data

Value

ScaledMatrix or IterableMatrix

Examples

m <- matrix(rnorm(100), nrow = 10)

standardise_flex(m)
